subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should the extra-CA path be explicitly process-startup-only and optimized now, or should this issue first provide a benchmark proving meaningful repeated connection cost?
rationale: Certificate trust is security-sensitive and the report has source-level plausibility but no measured current-main impact; maintainer intent is needed on the reload contract and evidence bar before dispatching a fix.

options.title: Require measured proof
options.body: Ask for a focused current-main benchmark or instrumentation showing repeated reads/parses before approving the process-lifetime cache.

options.title: Sponsor startup cache
options.body: Confirm certificate changes require process restart and allow a bounded cache patch with regression tests even without a broader benchmark.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Retain dynamic file observation if runtime certificate rotation is intentional and document that contract instead of caching.

recommendation.title: Require measured proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a focused current-main benchmark or instrumentation showing repeated reads/parses before approving the process-lifetime cache.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS startup work is the closest available history signal for this lifecycle decision.
